name: certified-adapters
title: Adapter certification
question: How much capacity does certifying adapters buy?
note: Certified tier-0/1 calls are bounded at 50 bps of notional instead of the full 10000, a 200:1 coverage reduction. The 50 bps figure is an ASSUMPTION taken from the protocol's own worked example (docs/papers/guardian-network-economic-security.md:152); real bounds are per-adapter in [1, 9999].
